subject: Service interruption: proposed consolation package and trial extension
messages:
From: Soham Singh <soham@brightleaf.com>
To: neha.kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brightleaf Support <support@brightleaf.com>
Date: 2026-09-03 08:42 AM -0700
Subject: Unexpected downtime this morning — impact and request for remediation

Hi Neha,

We saw a service interruption from ~07:15–07:48 PDT this morning where inference requests to model x-large failed with 503s. Our integration retries masked some issues, but we measured ~15% error rate during the window and a spike in tail latency for another hour. This affected our checkout validation flow and caused a measurable drop in conversion for two of our high-traffic shards.

Can you share the incident timeline and whether there's an automatic credit/remedy policy for events like this? We're evaluating options for a short-term mitigation (trial extension or credits) while we decide on a longer-term Dedicated plan.

I've attached our internal impact summary (short PDF). Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Soham Singh
Head of Integrations, Brightleaf
soham@brightleaf.com

Attachments: incident_report_brightleaf_0903.pdf

From: neha.kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Soham Singh <soham@brightleaf.com>
Cc: marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, stephanie.nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03 09:15 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected downtime this morning — impact and request for remediation

Hi Soham — thanks for the heads up and for the impact summary. I'm really sorry for the disruption this morning. We're pulling together the incident timeline and the root-cause analysis; I'll share an internal postmortem by EOD tomorrow.

Immediate next steps:
- I'm looping in Marissa from our account team to coordinate any commercial relief (trial extension / credits) and to make sure you have a dedicated contact.
- Stephanie (ops) will provide a detailed timeline and the mitigation steps that were taken.
- If you'd like a live walkthrough of the logs and retry behavior, we can set up a 30-min call this afternoon.

Would a 30-day trial extension plus a one-off credit be helpful as a starting point? If you can quantify the estimate of tokens or spend impacted, we can make an expedited approval request.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Tel: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: neha.kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, rafael.mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, stephanie.nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03 10:03 AM -0700
Subject: Proposed consolation package for Brightleaf — internal for approval

Team — quick proposal to resolve Brightleaf's impact and preserve the renewal momentum:

Proposal (subject to signoff):
- Apply a $6,000 service credit to Brightleaf's account (est. ~2 weeks of their current hosted spend).
- Issue a 30-day trial/seat extension on their evaluation environment (adds runway for switching to Dedicated).
- One complimentary performance review with our Solutions Eng team (2 hrs) to recommend batching/cache tweaks.

Rationale: they saw a clear outage during peak traffic; the credit plus extension is a reasonable customer-obsessed outcome and helps accelerate conversion.

Requesting Rafael and Finance to OK the $6k credit. Attaching a short approval form for signature.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: rafael.mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, neha.kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03 13:20 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed consolation package for Brightleaf — internal for approval

Thanks for the context. Finance reviewed prelim numbers — $6k is within our customer recovery allowance for accounts of this tier pending a short justification note. Please prep a two-paragraph justification (impact, proposed customer steps, expected ROI) and I'll sign the attached approval form. Once signed I'll route to billing to credit the account and to CS to apply the trial extension.

Accepting: credit amount: $6,000
Conditions: one-time, non-recurring concession; documented in account notes.

Rafael Mendes
Head of Customer Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

Attachment referenced: consolation_package_approval_form.pdf

From: neha.kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Soham Singh <soham@brightleaf.com>
Cc: marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, rafael.mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, stephanie.nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-05 14:10 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected downtime this morning — impact and request for remediation

Hi Soham — thanks for your patience. Quick update and next steps: 

1) Approved concession: Redwood has authorized a one-time $6,000 service credit to Brightleaf (applied to account BLF-2026-42).
2) Trial extension: we've extended your evaluation environment by 30 days (expires 2026-10-05).
3) Follow-up: Our Solutions Eng team (Marissa will coordinate) will schedule a 60-minute session to review batching and prefix caching recommendations.

I attached the signed approval form for your records. The billing team will apply the credit within 3 business days; I'll confirm once that's posted. If you'd like a brief call to walk through the postmortem and prevention plan, we're free tomorrow at 10:00 AM PDT — let me know if that works.

Again, apologies for the disruption and thanks for working through this with us.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Attachments: consolation_package_approval_form.pdf
